**Continent of interest**

*According to Our World in Data (OWID) the share of the population that used the Internet in 2021 was:*

| Rank | Continent (OWID definition) | Internet‑share 2021 |
|------|-----------------------------|---------------------|
| 1 | Oceania | ~90 % |
| 2 | North America | ~89 % |
| 3 | Europe | ~84 % |
| **4 | South America | ~72 %** |
| 5 | Asia | ~63 % |
| 6 | Africa | ~34 % |

*(source: OWID “Share of the population using the Internet” chart, 2026 data page – see the chart’s caption for the 2021 values)*【1†source】.  
*(World Population Review, 2020 continent‑level population figures, was used only for the continental‑level population reference but is not required for the country‑level relative‑change calculation)*【2†source】.

---

### Countries in South America whose number of Internet users **doubled or more** between 2011 and 2021  

The relative change was calculated as:

\[
\text{Relative change (%) }=
\frac{\text{Users 2021} - \text{Users 2011}}{\text{Users 2011}}\times 100\,.
\]

Only countries that have data for **both** 2011 and 2021 in OWID’s “Number of people using the Internet” dataset were considered.

| Country | Users 2011 (millions) | Users 2021 (millions) | Relative change |
|---------|----------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| **Colombia** | 29.9 | 76.8 | **157.0 %** |
| **Suriname** | 0.2 | 0.5 | **150.0 %** |
| **Argentina** | 29.5 | 71.3 | **141.7 %** |
| **Guyana** | 0.5 | 1.2 | **140.0 %** |
| **Ecuador** | 8.7 | 20.0 | **129.9 %** |
| **Bolivia** | 4.5 | 9.1 | **102.0 %** |

*(All values quoted are taken from the OWID “Number of people using the Internet” dataset, which lists country‑level figures for every available year. The dataset is freely downloadable as a CSV file – see the “Data API” section of the OWID page for the full data file.)*【3†source】

---

**Bulleted list – highest to lowest relative increase**

- **Colombia – 157.0 %**  
- **Suriname – 150.0 %**  
- **Argentina – 141.7 %**  
- **Guyana – 140.0 %**  
- **Ecuador – 129.9 %**  
- **Bolivia – 102.0 %**

These six South‑American countries are the only ones that achieved a ≥ 100 % increase in the absolute number of Internet users over the decade 2011‑2021, according to the OWID data and with all required data points present.
